hints.title: Run Length Stack
hints.text: Maintain run-length encoded blocks of consecutive identical characters.

hints.title: Immediate Reduction Condition
hints.text: When the top two stack blocks represent zeros followed by ones and both have counts at least k, subtract k from both counts.

hints.title: Adjacent Merging
hints.text: After removing exhausted blocks, check if adjacent blocks of the same character can be combined.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time processing using run-length encoded stack.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string replacement causes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory stores character run blocks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a stack of runs to handle cascaded reductions seamlessly.
